- Skill version incremented to 0.1.1 without modifications to content or functionality.

Initial release of the DocuSeal skill.

- Manage DocuSeal document templates and e-signatures via MCP endpoint.
- Provides CLI script for searching, creating templates, sending documents, and searching documents.
- Requires environment variables DOCUSEAL_URL and DOCUSEAL_MCP_TOKEN.
- All interactions use JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP POST.
- Supports Node.js 18+ with no external dependencies.
